description: PLATFORM-FIDELITY-01 Diamond Princess training pair: the boxed sect_mess_boxed replica (SOP-017-MESSBOX + boxed service block, theta 7.9e6, seeds 20200205-20200224) replayed on the event-faithful diamond_princess hull vs the generic mega_cruise_5000 proxy it currently rides, everything else held fixed. Pre-registered sensitivity measurement; no Theta selection, no canonical-platform crowning.
base_overrides_note: The boxed crew-mess configuration, verbatim from covid_crew_mess_01_design.json arm sect_mess_boxed (the DP believability operating point per docs/covid/covid_dp_replay_handoff_2026_10_09.md section 2), applied by campaigns/covid/platform_fidelity_01/cell.py after prepare_cell_run_spec. Frozen reading of the handoff's 'SOP-017 only' protocol discipline: the per-event-pair protocols file carries the single scheduled protocol id the cell resolves (SOP-017-MESSBOX here, SOP-017 on GM) and no reactive protocols; the frozen file is data/config/protocols_covid_pf_dp.json.
cells_note: 1 theta x 1 infection_age x 1 imports x 2 arms x 20 seeds = 40 cells. Seeded in-order per arm (20200205..20200224); the same seed list on both arms gives the CRN pairing.
cell_payload_additions_note: The crew-mess-01 payload set plus this campaign's platform_fidelity echo block: resolved platform_id, protocols_path, per-input-file SHA-256 hashes, and the set of protocol ids the protocol engine activated during the voyage (with the close_zones-firing audit flag).

arms.note: First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. Rides the scenario's declared proxy platform mega_cruise_5000 (the hull every prior boxed DP campaign ran on). The declared baseline.
Same cell on the event-faithful diamond_princess hull (159 zones, 57 AHUs; PR #1167). The only difference from the baseline arm is catalog.platform_id.

metrics: paired hull delta: per-seed dedicated - proxy recorded_onsets (takeoff-conditional: seeds where BOTH arms record >= 10 onsets), median delta with q05-q95
P(takeoff) per hull: fraction of the 20 seeds with recorded_onsets >= 10
takeoff-conditional asymptomatic share of lab_confirmed per hull
CRN pairing diagnostic: Pearson correlation of recorded_onsets across the two arms over both-takeoff seeds (rho < 0.3 -> unpaired analysis declared)
failed-comparison audit: any cell whose protocol engine fired a close_zones protocol is a FAILED COMPARISON, reported, never deleted
freeze.minimum_detectable_effect: 30% of the proxy arm's takeoff-conditional median recorded_onsets, declared at prereg review
report_immediately: any cell where a close_zones protocol fired (FAILED COMPARISON)
the paired delta's q05-q95 interval excluding zero

submission_order: canary: the two DP blocks (40 cells) - read out and STOP; GM blocks and any further array are the owner's call after the canary report
